name: gradient-october-silenceiver

frames.best_why: The full diagonal blend reads clearly, from cyan at the left to violet at the right.

tagline: Cyan blue slides diagonally into vivid violet across a rounded panel.
summary: A decorative slightly diagonal gradient block that starts in bright cyan-blue, passes through periwinkle, and ends in vivid violet-magenta at the far edge.
appearance: A wide rounded rectangle filled by a shallow diagonal gradient from bright cyan-blue on the left, through periwinkle blue, to a vivid violet-magenta on the right. Black margins frame it.
behaviour: Static: nothing moves or responds. The two saturated colour stops are fixed, though classes or inline styles can resize and repaint the block.
use_when: A vivid cool-toned field is wanted behind a hero, card or announcement.
avoid_when: Its saturated stops are static and bright, so delicate text or quiet layouts will fight it.
customise: The two gradient stops are baked into the inline style; pass className or style to resize, round or repaint it, otherwise edit the file.
weight_why: One div with a CSS gradient and no script.

a11y.note: Decorative only: no text, controls or focus, so it conveys no information by itself.

polish_why: Smooth diagonal blend with clean corners; striking but still a stock two-colour gradient.
